LanguageData.Shell_BaitTarget.label: Electronic Decoy Shell
LanguageData.Shell_BaitTarget.description: A special mortar round that generates an electronic decoy signal on impact, diverting aerial bombers to a new target. Used to redirect airstrikes to a chosen location. "Best way to use it: drop it right on the raiders. They'll get blown sky-high by their own 'support'!" — An anonymous soldier
